assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied albedo texture into its MATCHING grayscale height/displacement data map. Preserve exact image framing, orientation, feature coordinates, scale and tile boundaries: no regeneration or rearrangement of the pattern. This is surface DEPTH DATA, NOT a black-and-white photograph, not shading or an ambient occlusion map. White means raised, black means recessed, medium gray means flat. Remove all albedo colors, stains, shadows and lighting; do not interpret color changes as large height changes. Pure neutral grayscale, no alpha, labels, borders, highlights or perspective. Smooth simplified low-frequency height relief, broad smooth value fields with minimal grain so it compresses well, no added fine noise. Seamless across opposite edges. Output a single texture, no comparisons, no rendered 3D relief. 1024x1024 square. Wind-packed snow. Existing wind ridges gently raised pale gray, existing troughs gently lower middle gray. Shallow continuous undulations, no newly invented ridges or objects, eliminate surface sparkle.
